message: The astro target does not support context: Astro renders each component on its own, with no tree of instances to provide to, so `inject` gives its fallback (ADR-0054).

The astro target does not support interactivity: Astro components render on the server only, and each render is a new instance: event handlers, template refs, watchers and lifecycle hooks never run, and state keeps its initial value.
The astro target does not support context: Astro renders each component on its own, with no tree of instances to provide to, so `inject` gives its fallback (ADR-0054).
